patches.why: Safari writes the whole wasm heap to OPFS when given a view into it, so crash-recovery snapshots and meta were 15 MB of garbage and nothing was recovered; the bytes are copied first

The web build never autosaved: no recovery storage, and its autosave timer never fired (now_ms() is 0 on wasm), so a reload or crashed tab lost unsaved documents (storytold/photocraft#6615). Uses craft-web-recovery from the craft-libs override.

craft-web-recovery: crash-recovery copies of unsaved documents in the browser (IndexedDB, one Web Lock per tab, counted only after commit), the unload guard and download helpers; shared by every app's web save fixes, not in storytold's craft-libs yet (storytold/craft-libs#124)
